questions.stem_text: Why is the danger inherent in the issuance of fiat money?

options.A: It is often used to meet emergencies.
options.B: Its quantity is controlled by the government rather than by market forces.
options.C: It is backed by a physical commodity like gold or silver.
options.D: It encourages the accumulation of debt through interest-free loans.
options.E: It is used for buying military supplies during a war.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: B - Its quantity is controlled by the government rather than by market forces.

questions.stem_text: Production possibilities frontiers are concave to the origin because

options.A: of the principle of comparative advantage.
options.B: of the existence of fixed resources.
options.D: of the law of decreasing costs.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - of the principle of comparative advantage.

questions.stem_text:
What might happen to the housing construction industry if com-mercial banks are allowed to
compete freely with mutual sav-ings banks?

options.A: The quality of housing construction would deteriorate
options.D: Mutual savings banks would become obsolete
options.E: Deposits in mutual savings banks would increase

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: C - The housing industry would slump

questions.stem_text: A negative or contractionary supply shock will

options.A: shift the Phillips curve to the left.
options.B: shift the investment demand curve to the right.
options.C: shift the money demand curve to the right.
options.D: shift the Phillips curve to the right.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: D - shift the Phillips curve to the right.

questions.stem_text: Continuously compounded returns can be directly added over time to yield total returns for any given period.
questions.answer_explanation: LLM-generated false statement. Correct answer: 'They can be added across a portfolio of assets to give portfolio returns'.
